name: Workspace Plugin
description: Provides the workspace sidebar and flyout as pluggable extensions.

sidebarPosition.title: Sidebar Position
sidebarPosition.description: Position of the sidebar and navigation menu.

sidebarWidth.title: Sidebar Width
sidebarWidth.description: Width of the sidebar in pixels.

flyoutMode.title: Flyout Menu Mode
flyoutMode.description: Choose how the flyout menu behaves: layout mode pushes content aside, floating mode overlays content.

sidebarLogoUrl.title: Sidebar Logo URL
sidebarLogoUrl.description: URL for an image/logo to display at the top of the sidebar. Overrides logo text if set.

showUserAvatar.title: Show User Avatar
showUserAvatar.description: Show or hide the user avatar at the bottom.

sidebarLogoText.title: Sidebar Logo Text
sidebarLogoText.description: Text to display as the sidebar logo.
